intro: The Voodoo Charm is a mystical talisman used within the barrows of Teldrassil to sever a sinister enchantment. Handed to adventurers by the spirit of Oben Rageclaw, it allows his corrupted, puppeted physical form to be permanently released so his soul may rest in the Emerald Dream.
